title: The Gaussian structure of a perturbed KPZ
summary: We study the KPZ equation on a circle with an additive spatial perturbation $\partial_t h=\tfrac12Δh+\tfrac12|\nabla h|^2+ξ+ V$, where $ξ$ is a spacetime white noise and $V$ is a smooth spatial function. When $V=0$, it is well-known that the unique invariant measure is the Brownian bridge. In the presence of the perturbation, we show that the equation admits a unique invariant measure that is absolutely continuous with respect to the Brownian bridge.
